title: W2b with arrived packets processed before the runqueue
note: Prediction: with packets processed before the runqueue, the part of the short requests' wait before their thread exists (9 us at rho 0.8, 15 us at 0.9) shrinks to a few us, so prio's short wait and p99 drop further; fifo gains little in ordering (it still runs the oldest), and long requests pay a little.
